% test-chapneg with no space above a chapter, \titlespacing's {0pt}, which
% in the PDF puts the title at the top of a new page. On the page, the
% heading has the default space below the text above it, as for a
% negative space, and not none.
\documentclass{book}
\usepackage{titlesec,makeidx}
\makeindex
\titleformat{\chapter}[display]{\normalfont\huge\bfseries}
    {\chaptertitlename\ \thechapter}{20pt}{\Huge}
\titlespacing{\chapter}{0pt}{0pt}{20pt}
\begin{document}
\input{test-chapneg-cases.ltx}
